verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual says SSH keys can live on the Secure Enclave, which is hardware-backed, and are protected by Face ID or Touch ID. That covers every element of the story, and the manual also notes keys can be generated inside the app. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Secure Enclave key setup and its limits (e.g., supported key types), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can store my SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave protected by biometrics

citations.quote: For extra security SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.
